clue.text: Old-fashioned member on the cricket field

definitions.note: describes a fielding position, a place on the field occupied by a fielder

parts.note: a square is a fuddy-duddy, someone conventional and old-fashioned
a leg is a limb, a member of the body

explanation.surface: An elderly club member is out fielding in a cricket match.
explanation.walkthrough: SQUARE LEG is a cricket fielding position level with the batsman on the leg side; cricket is a bat-and-ball game played mostly in Britain and the Commonwealth.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names a fielder's station level with the batsman, a position on a cricket pitch.

clue.text: Does this bird show a yellow streak?

definitions.meaning: a small game bird of the partridge family
to cower or flinch in fear, a yellow streak being cowardice

explanation.definitionFit: The bird is a small partridge-like fowl; as a verb the word means to shrink back in fear, as a coward does.

clue.text: Passionate study in art

indicators.note: the study is placed within the word art, so in signals a container

parts.note: taken as written
a den is a private study or snug room

explanation.surface: Someone devotes keen study to art.
explanation.definitionFit: Ardent and passionate are synonyms describing fervent feeling.

clue.text: To Eric it is strangely amatory

indicators.note: the letters of to eric are arranged strangely, in an odd new order

explanation.surface: Someone finds that Eric's taste is oddly romantic.
explanation.definitionFit: Amatory means relating to sexual love, the same sense as sensual or arousing.

clue.text: Banish former Portuguese leader with the Spanish

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter, taken here from portuguese

parts.note: el is the Spanish word for the

explanation.surface: An ex-ruler of Portugal is exiled along with Spaniards.
explanation.definitionFit: To expel someone is to banish or drive them out.

clue.text: Following the trend to a certain extent

definitions.meaning: read literally: coming after, in pursuit of, the current style
an idiom meaning somewhat, after a sort, not fully

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means in a rough or partial way; read literally it means coming behind the current mode.

clue.text: Indication of those being taken for a ride?

definitions.text: Indication of those being taken for a ride?

parts.words: Indication of those being taken for a ride?
parts.note: being taken for a ride suggests being swindled, but here it is simply being carried as travellers, and the indication is a roster of their names

explanation.definitionFit: A roll of travellers aboard a ship or plane records everyone being carried on the journey.

clue.text: Too frightened for words?

parts.note: the idiom for being speechless with fear read literally: too scared to utter any words

explanation.definitionFit: Someone too scared to say anything is fearful of uttering a word, literally frightened of words.

clue.text: Animal on southern headland is wrongly blamed

indicators.note: the animal is placed on, following after, the southern headland pieces

parts.note: a cape is a headland jutting into the sea
a goat is an animal

explanation.surface: A goat grazing on a southern promontory gets the blame for something it did not do.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads as a verb sense: to blame someone wrongly for others' faults.
explanation.definitionFit: To make someone bear the blame for others' wrongs is the verb sense of this word.

clue.text: One forced to study the text

parts.note: con is an old word meaning to study or learn by heart
a script is the written text of a play

explanation.surface: Someone is made to learn their lines.
explanation.definitionFit: A conscript is a person compelled into military service, someone made to serve.

clue.text: Caught river fish in this?

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
an eel is a fish

explanation.surface: An angler stores the river catch in a basket.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines the angler's wicker basket while also giving the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A creel is a wicker basket an angler uses to carry caught fish.

clue.text: Means of catching girl with a ring

parts.note: a lass is a girl
O is a ring because of its shape

explanation.surface: A man tries to win a girl with an engagement ring.
explanation.definitionFit: A lasso is a looped rope used by cowboys to catch cattle.

clue.text: Keep a supply of goods for sale

definitions.meaning: to keep goods on hand, as a shop does

definitions.text: a supply of goods for sale

explanation.definitionFit: A shop that keeps an item has it on its shelves; its goods for sale are its inventory.

clue.text: Unpleasant, my finishing underwater

indicators.note: my comes finishing, at the end after the other piece

parts.note: under water is at sea, the sea being the water above
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone ends up nastily beneath the waves.
explanation.definitionFit: Seamy means sordid or disreputable, as in the seamy side of life.

clue.text: Neat-edged bloomer?

parts.note: neat is an old word for cattle, and an ox is one
edged suggests a lip, the edge or rim of a vessel

explanation.surface: A neatly trimmed flower, or an embarrassing mistake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Neat' looks like tidy but is the old word for cattle; 'bloomer' is a flower, not a blunder.
explanation.definitionFit: The oxlip is a primrose-like wild flower, and a flower is something that blooms.

clue.text: Canoe stays upright even when overturned

indicators.note: the word reads the same when reversed, so turning it over leaves it unchanged

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A canoe that never capsizes.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue, reading upwards gives the same letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A kayak is a covered canoe of Inuit origin.

clue.text: Film an ornamental tablet

definitions.meaning: the sticky film of bacteria that coats teeth
a decorative plate fixed to a wall

explanation.definitionFit: Dental plaque is a film on teeth; a commemorative wall plate is the other sense.

clue.text: The pineapple, long fruit with the top removed

indicators.note: the first letter, the top of the word, is taken away

parts.note: bananas are long fruit

explanation.surface: Someone compares a pineapple with a long fruit that has been trimmed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with the top removed' takes B from BANANAS. ANANAS is the French and botanical name for the pineapple.
explanation.definitionFit: Ananas is the botanical genus name and the European word for pineapple.

clue.text: Join about nothing in temper

indicators.note: the join word goes about the nothing, enclosing it

parts.note: to ally is to join with
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Someone flies into a temper over nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: To alloy is to temper or debase a metal by mixing in a baser one.

clue.text: Man a key artist, not a good actor

parts.note: G is a musical key
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
a ham is a poor overacting actor

explanation.surface: A man in a theatre is a fine painter but a poor performer.
explanation.walkthrough: RA, a Royal Academician, is a member of the Royal Academy of Arts in London.
explanation.definitionFit: Graham is a male first name, so it stands for a man.

clue.text: It would seem to be a soft fruit

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for soft
a pear is a fruit

explanation.surface: Something looks like a squashy piece of fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: To appear is to seem or look a certain way.

clue.text: One animal or another going round the river

indicators.note: the yak goes round the river, enclosing it

parts.note: a yak is another animal
the Po is the great river of northern Italy

explanation.surface: Two animals circle a river.
explanation.definitionFit: The yapok is the water opossum of South and Central America, a creature.

clue.text: Very much likes little Desmond or a revolutionary

indicators.note: a revolution turns things around, so these letters are overturned into a new order

parts.note: Des is a short form of the name Desmond

explanation.surface: Someone is fond of young Desmond, or else of a rebel.
explanation.definitionFit: To adore someone is to love them dearly.

clue.text: Different topics in science

indicators.note: a different arrangement of the letters is called for

explanation.surface: A scientist covers various subjects.
explanation.definitionFit: Optics is the branch of physics studying light and vision.

clue.text: So he by right joined the tribe

parts.note: as can mean so, in the sense of because

explanation.surface: A man rightfully became a tribal member.
explanation.walkthrough: Asher is one of the twelve tribes of Israel in the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: Asher, son of Jacob, gave his name to one of the twelve Israelite tribes.

clue.text: Proportion of allowance cut short

indicators.note: the last letter is cut off, shortening the word

parts.note: a ration is a fixed allowance

explanation.surface: Part of someone's allowance is reduced.
explanation.definitionFit: A ratio expresses the proportion of one quantity to another.

clue.text: A bulb possibly lit up

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters may be arranged otherwise

explanation.surface: A light bulb may be switched on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges LITUP; the bulb is a flower bulb, not a lamp.
explanation.definitionFit: The tulip grows from a bulb, a flower of the lily family.

clue.text: Strained in the past perhaps

definitions.meaning: the past is one example of a verb's time form

explanation.definitionFit: Tense means taut or anxious; the past is an example of a grammatical tense.

clue.text: Honestly he's a twister

parts.note: a twister suggests a swindler, but this performer genuinely twists his body

explanation.definitionFit: A performer who bends his body into extraordinary shapes is literally someone who twists.

clue.text: Studies various diets it was made up from

parts.note: to con is to study, so cons means studies

indicators.note: various suggests the letters are set in a varied new order

explanation.surface: Someone researches a range of diets to see what they contained.
explanation.definitionFit: To consist of something is to be composed or formed of it.
